name: dgdtools
description: DGD-dialect LPC: syntax highlighting, and the dgdtools language server (diagnostics as you type, fixes, formatting) for the language `dgdlpc`.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace that is not trusted, the workspace's own values of dgdtools.path and dgdtools.logFile are ignored: the server that runs is the one you chose.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The language server reads files on disk. In a virtual workspace there is highlighting only.

commands.title: Treat This Folder as an LPC Lib
Stop Treating This Folder as an LPC Lib

dgdtools.path.markdownDescription: The `dgdtools` executable to run as the language server: an absolute path (`~` is your home directory), or a command name to look up on `PATH`. Empty: the `dgdtools` this extension came with (the package for your platform has one), else `dgdtools` on `PATH`.

dgdtools.profile.markdownDescription: The mudlib profile to work against in a folder that has no `dgdtools.yml`: a name or a file, as `profile:` in a config file. A config file always wins over this.

dgdtools.libPath.markdownDescription: Where a folder that has no `dgdtools.yml` sits in the lib (for example `/players/me`), as `lib_path:` in a config file. A config file always wins over this.

dgdtools.logFile.markdownDescription: A file the server appends its debug log to (`dgdtools lsp --log FILE`): an absolute path (`~` is your home directory). Empty: no log.

enumDescriptions: The name of each message, and how long a request took.
The content of each message too.
dgdtools.trace.server.markdownDescription: How much of what the editor and the server say to each other is traced. The trace is made while the log level of the *dgdtools* channel of the Output panel is *Trace* (the gear of the panel, or *Developer: Set Log Level…*), and is shown there.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build -- --minify
